contract: One original activity crosses its authored start-to-close deadline in real wall time. Its original attempt refuses late completion, and one timeout retry retains the same execution, entire policy and original schedule-to-close deadline. An actual second claim uses a new task/attempt after the original backoff, completes once before its deadline, and the original workflow completes with exact Avro int64/null/Unicode values. After both authored deadlines have genuinely elapsed, identical submissions never append another event or command. Closed activity 409/stale_attempt/outcome=completed/recorded=false and closed workflow 409/run_closed are permitted; they do not prove submitted-content equality. A retained content-verified receipt may acknowledge its original commit. Conflicting activity output remains refused. No database timestamp, server clock, original deadline or observer budget is rewritten. HTTP uses normal installed Client worker-protocol requests; embedded must use a real queue author and public bridges. This pending follow-through requires both references and native qualification before adoption. Receipt boundary: https://github.com/durable-workflow/server/issues/325#issuecomment-6155987239 .
